_help: Act 2, the museum, first visit (one action): the chief archivist refuses, names Eleanor and Pembroke (knows_eleanor, knows_pembroke), and you may approach ONE of them in the same visit (the el_ / pe_ nodes are act2_eleanor / act2_pembroke). Later visits use the find_ actions. Until you learn the names (museum_staff_known) you can come back and ask again. Threatening him: archivist_hostile + event fight_museum_guards (end_fight); Eleanor saw it (knows_eleanor). The 200-pound donation (archivist_bribed) opens the locked cabinet in act2_archive. Generated by tools/dialogue/make_act2.py.

again.speaker: archivist
again.line: You again. My answer has not improved overnight.

first.speaker: archivist
first.line: Another treasure hunter. This is a museum, sir, not a hiring hall. State your business, and be brief.

choices.label: Ask for an Egyptologist
choices.line: I'm putting together a private expedition. I need an Egyptologist, and they tell me you have the best in Cairo.

choices.label: Mention Akmentar
choices.line: We're going after the tombs of Akmentar.

myth.speaker: archivist
myth.line: Akmentar is a story camel drivers tell tourists for a few piastres. There is no tomb, and there never was.

ask.speaker: archivist
ask.line: Absolutely not. No scholar of this museum will be seen chasing fairy tales with a hired gun.

choices.label: Ask about his staff
choices.line: Surely not everyone here agrees with you.

choices.label: Offer a donation
choices.line: The museum could use a generous donation. Shall we say two hundred pounds?

choices.label: Threaten him
choices.line: Find me someone, Professor, or I'll make this your problem. Personally.

bribe.speaker: archivist
bribe.line: Two hundred pounds buys the museum a display case. It does not buy you my staff. It may buy you a look at our basement, if you insist on wasting your time.

staff.speaker: archivist
staff.line: Two of my people might be foolish enough. Miss Whitmore believes every legend she translates. Dr. Pembroke believes nothing he cannot catalogue, and badly needs a success.

pick.speaker: archivist
pick.line: Speak to one of them, if you must. The other I need at work today.

choices.label: Approach Miss Whitmore
choices.line: Miss Whitmore? A word, if you have one.

choices.label: Approach Dr. Pembroke
choices.line: Dr. Pembroke? A moment of your time.

threat.speaker: archivist
threat.line: You dare threaten me in my own museum? Guards! Remove this man!

el_already.speaker: eleanor
el_already.line: I've packed my notebooks twice already. Tell me we leave soon.

el_first.speaker: eleanor
el_first.line: Eleanor Whitmore. I read the inscriptions the Professor can't be bothered with. You'll need someone who can read the walls out there.

el_fee.speaker: eleanor
el_fee.line: The museum pays me one hundred pounds a month. I'll come for the same.

choices.label: Pay her properly
choices.line: Three hundred. It's a scholar's work.

choices.label: Pay nothing yet
choices.line: You'll get your share when we find it.

choices.label: Leave
choices.line: Sorry to have bothered you, miss.

el_joined.speaker: eleanor
el_joined.line: Then I'm coming. I'll fetch my things before the Professor finds out.

el_joined_cool.speaker: eleanor
el_joined_cool.line: Fine. I'm coming anyway. But I'm keeping my own notes.

pe_already.speaker: pembroke
pe_already.line: My equipment is crated and labelled. Every crate. I trust yours is too.

pe_first.speaker: pembroke
pe_first.line: Dr. Arthur Pembroke, field archaeologist. Seven hundred pounds, in advance, and I run the excavation records.

pe_homework.speaker: pembroke
pe_homework.line: You're the one who signed out the Akmentar boxes. You've actually read them. Very well. Five hundred.

pe_haggle.speaker: pembroke
pe_haggle.line: I am not a porter to be haggled with. Seven hundred.

pe_broke.speaker: pembroke
pe_broke.line: Then try Dr. Hassan al-Masri in the old quarter. The museum dismissed him for less.

pe_joined.speaker: pembroke
pe_joined.line: Very well. I shall want a proper camera, and someone who can hold it still.
